name: The Editorial Studio
description: Warm paper, ink, serif accents, and generous project imagery. A personal studio with serious craft.
approach: A calm introduction, then the work. Balances small-team warmth with engineering credibility.

name: Clarity by Design
description: Black, white, and signal red. Oversized type, a strict grid, and a portfolio that does the talking.
approach: Treats the agency as a disciplined design practice. Minimal decoration and direct, high-contrast communication.

name: The Common Ground
description: Cobalt and citron, open geometric forms, and a people-first tone. Civic purpose is part of the whole studio.
approach: Leads with shared purpose. Gives commercial, product, and civic work equal space from the first screen.

name: Field Notes
description: Forest green, uncoated paper, expressive serif type, and a working collection of projects.
approach: A maker’s portfolio. Emphasizes the people, decisions, and care behind the finished product.

name: Build Mode
position: Technical depth, visible from the start.
description: A dark engineering studio with phosphor-green type, interactive project briefs, and precise interface details.
approach: Leads with the ability to build. Best for founders and teams looking for a strong technical partner.

name: Make It Matter
description: Vermilion, huge typography, graphic shapes, and a colorful, full-volume presentation of the work.
approach: A memorable creative agency. Uses strong graphic composition to project ambition and momentum.

name: The Work Speaks
position: Show the result before explaining the process.
description: A dark, immersive project gallery with an interactive lead project and understated studio branding.
approach: Portfolio first. Lets visitors move through real work immediately, then introduces the team behind it.

name: Built to Spec
position: One capable team for the whole job.
description: Technical blue, measured layouts, a project diagram, and an architectural approach to digital delivery.
approach: Develops the general-contractor idea into a visual system. Makes scope, coordination, and delivery tangible.

name: A Little Unexpected
description: Violet, butter yellow, rounded shapes, and an audience selector. Playful presentation, practical substance.
approach: A contemporary creative and product studio. Makes the site feel exploratory, welcoming, and alive.

name: Built on Trust
description: Oxblood, ivory, classic typography, and finely framed work. A more institutional and enduring agency presence.
approach: Reassures established businesses and civic organizations. Puts experience and stewardship ahead of novelty.
